The depends_on entry for azurerm_management_group.level_1 is redundant: the triggers attribute references azurerm_management_group.level_1 (jsonencode(keys(...))), which already creates an implicit dependency.

azapi_resource.diag_settings sets body.properties.workspaceId to local.template_file_variables.log_analytics_workspace_resource_id, which is a static string derived from the management sub-module configuration and creates no Terraform data dependency on azurerm_log_analytics_workspace.management. When the Log Analytics workspace is created in the same apply (deploy_management_resources = true), the Management Group diagnostic settings can be created before the workspace exists and will fail. azapi_resource.data_collection_rule targeting the same workspace already declares this depends_on.
